speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; please describe your symptoms in your own words, including when they started and how they have progressed. Additionally, could you list any other significant medical conditions or medications you are currently taking?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for describing that; the "drunk-like" appearance of your gait and right-sided clumsiness suggests cerebellar dysfunction. To narrow down the cause, has this ataxia been steadily progressive, or did it start suddenly? Also, do you experience any numbness, weakness, or changes in your vision?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Multiple sclerosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.
